name: B10-0451/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep and expand sanctions against Belarus's leaders. It asks for the release of all political prisoners and for help for Belarusians who have fled abroad. It wants the United Nations to keep watching human rights there and to hold those responsible to account. It also condemns the treatment of detained people, of LGBTI+ people, and of Ukrainian children taken to Belarus. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to extend sanctions against Belarus past February 2026 and to add more names.
- It urges the UN to keep its human rights experts on Belarus working beyond 2026.
- It calls for easier visas and residence permits for Belarusians fleeing political persecution.
